seo.title: Best Choice Products: AI optimization of Sponsored Products on Walmart Connect - ROAS +27%, attributed sales +50% (2024)
seo.meta_description: Best Choice Products handed its Walmart Connect Sponsored Products to Quartile's AI: ROAS +27%, conversions +17%, and attributed revenue +50% on an October 2024 test.
seo.resume_citable: Best Choice Products had its Sponsored Products campaigns on Walmart Connect driven by Quartile's AI (bids, budget, and placements in real time) and reports, on an October 2024 test, a ROAS up 27%, conversions up 17%, and attributed revenue up 50%.

faq.q: What does Quartile's AI do on Walmart Connect?
faq.a: It adjusts bids in real time, reallocates budgets, and refines placements on the Walmart site and app, drawing on conversion and engagement data.

faq.q: Over what period were these results measured?
faq.a: On a test from October 10 to 25, 2024, with Walmart first-party data comparing the past year to the previous one.

pattern: real-time AI optimization of bids, budget, and placement on retail media
objectif_business: Make the Sponsored Products budget work on Walmart without manual micro-management, letting the AI adjust bids, budgets, and placements as demand shifts.
description: Best Choice Products, a furniture, toys, and outdoor goods brand sold on Walmart, handed its Sponsored Products campaigns to Quartile, an ad-tech partner in the Walmart Connect Partner Network. Quartile's technology adjusts bids in real time, reallocates budgets, and refines placements on the Walmart site and app, drawing on conversion and engagement data to target by device and moment. Over a test period from October 10 to 25, 2024, the brand achieved a ROAS up 27 percent, conversions up 17 percent, and attributed revenue up 50 percent. This is a case of optimization and automation of media buying on retail media, not creative generation.
points_cles: AI optimization of Sponsored Products on Walmart Connect (bids, budget, placements in real time).
Operated by the partner Quartile in Managed Serve via the Walmart Connect API.
October 2024 test: ROAS +27%, conversions +17%, attributed sales +50%.
Evidence level B, confirmed active status.

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified Walmart Connect platform case study naming Best Choice Products and the ad-tech partner Quartile; official interested source, hence B. The case and Quartile's role are corroborated by a second publication from the partner.

stack_technique.detail: AI optimization technology that adjusts bids, budgets, and placements of Sponsored Products campaigns in real time via the Walmart Connect API.
Walmart's retail media network (Sponsored Products on site and app), which provides the first-party conversion and engagement data.
Managed offering operated by Quartile, a Walmart Connect Partner Network partner: the agency runs the optimization for the brand.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous, in real time: bids, budgets, and placements are recalculated as demand shifts.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The brand's retail media team, with Quartile in Managed Serve (the agency runs the optimization).
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The Walmart conversion and engagement data (by device and moment). Without reliable conversion feedback, the AI can neither reallocate the budget nor refine the placements.

etapes.detail: The Sponsored Products campaigns are structured in Walmart Connect via Quartile.
The AI adjusts bids, reallocates budgets, and refines placements on site and app.
Analysis of conversion and engagement data to target by device (desktop, mobile, app).
Tracking of ROAS, conversions, and attributed revenue to validate the allocation.

prerequis_data: catalog sold on a retail media network
conversion and engagement feedback from the retailer
prerequis_orga: ad-tech partner or team able to operate the retail media API
stack_possible: equivalent on Amazon Ads or Criteo
replication.premiere_etape: Hand a batch of Sponsored Products campaigns to an AI optimization layer and compare ROAS and conversions to manual management over the same period.

playbook.action: Check the catalog (product pages, stock, prices) and the retailer's conversion feedback, then define the test campaign batch and the target ROAS.
playbook.livrable: Locked test scope with the manual-management baseline.

playbook.action: Connect the Sponsored Products campaigns to the AI optimization layer (API access, setting of objectives and caps).
Let the learning run without manual micro-adjustments, monitoring spend, placements, and delivery pace.
Compare ROAS, conversions, and attributed revenue to manual management over an equivalent period, then decide on expansion.
playbook.livrable: Quantified assessment and decision to expand the scope.

replication.equipe: 1 retail media lead on the brand side; the daily optimization is carried by the partner (Managed Serve).

statut_vivant.note: Walmart Connect and Quartile automation are standard, active setups; the case is published in Walmart Connect's 2025 library.

transposable_ue.note: Walmart Connect is a US retail media network; the pattern (AI bid and budget optimization on a retail media network) is transposable in Europe via other networks (Amazon, Criteo, local retailers). Quartile's AI layer applies where the retail media API allows it.
